reason: Composition patterns for the editor provider and its rendered view.
The provider holds per-panel state and must re-scan on every document change; stale state is this child's main failure mode.
Code standards and forbidden patterns for the editor and webview code.
The webview <-> extension message protocol is a layer boundary; its payload shape must not be improvised in the view.
Display rules, labels and suffixes that the rendering must reproduce come from this analysis.
